items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I saw Art Hodes was working in a club in the Village and, uh, I can't just name the club but it was Art Hodes, and Moore on the drums - Freddie Moore

ctx.x: Somebody stabbed the checkroom girl and some fag got killed in there and they closed it up. So, now you know it's not easy to get a place open like that, to beat all those things and they're very

particular about what goes in there after a thing like that happens. So, they kept postponing his opening and Art Hodes and, so, I saw Art Hodes was working in a club in the Village and, uh, I can't just name the club but it was Art Hodes, and Moore on the drums - Freddie Moore---

items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: then I came back or either extended the engagement when Max had left with Wild Bill Davison and Freddy Moore

ctx.x: But they let me go. They believed me then that I hadn't seen anything. And I never saw the guy, I don't know what he looked like. But this was one of my first writeups.

This is how impressed you get, when you make the New York scene. That's it. So these were the early struggles in New York, until you start getting a few other breaks. Village Vanguard was a break. You go in there with your own trio, and I went in there with Max Kaminsky and Freddy Moore and then I came back or either extended the engagement when Max had left with Wild Bill Davison and Freddy Moore, working off as the group -- the Lion of Trinidad, who was a calypso innovator, and writer. He wrote that tune,…

So he was there. Pearl Bailey -- I saw Pearl Bailey on that floor, she was making either $40 or $75 a week. And Max Gordon, the big impresario, standing in the back with me, saying, I don't know what's wrong with that gal, there's something I can quite figure out. You know what he figured out? He bought the Blue Angel on the East Side with a partner, and within a couple of years, he's paying Pearl Bailey $1500 a week, and she hasn't changed a bit of that act. That's what he figured out.
